scenarios.name: Hide and restore a panel from the left-docked ribbon context menu

scenario_steps.name: the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left
the user opens the ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels
the user selects Modify in Show Panels
the Modify group disappears from the side-docked ribbon
the remaining ribbon groups reflow vertically
the user reopens Show Panels from the ribbon context menu
the user selects Modify in Show Panels
the Modify group returns to the side-docked ribbon
the remaining ribbon groups return to their earlier positions
